verdict.rationale: Manufact is a cloud platform that hosts MCP servers and routes request data through its gateway and across LLM models, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no documented control, policy, or setting that keeps user data out of AI model training. The 'Capture payloads' toggle governs whether request bodies are stored for observability, which is an adjacent control and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
